title: Comprehensive Research Summary: Bounds on the Binary Chvátal–Sankoff Constant γ₂
problem: Determine the Chvátal–Sankoff constant γ₂ = lim_{n→∞} E[LCS(X,Y)]/n for two independent uniform random binary strings X,Y of length n

lower.method: Lueker feasible-triplet framework with optimized parameters

bounds_table.method: Avg γ_W over random period-8 words

novel_contributions.name: Bernoulli LPP correlation gap
novel_contributions.description: The gap between Bernoulli LPP (independent weights, exact constant 2(√2−1) ≈ 0.8284) and true LCS (correlated weights) is consistently ≈ 0.021 at n=200. This suggests γ₂ ≤ 0.808, which if made rigorous would beat Lueker's 2009 upper bound of 0.826280.
novel_contributions.improvement_over_prior: Would reduce upper bound by 0.018 (from 0.826 to 0.808)

novel_contributions.name: Frog dynamics for random periodic words
novel_contributions.description: Some specific period-8 binary words achieve γ_W > 0.805 in the Bukh-Cox frog dynamics framework, suggesting these words are near-optimal for the periodic-vs-random LCS problem.
novel_contributions.improvement_over_prior: Identifies candidate words for improved lower bounds

novel_contributions.name: DFA optimal automaton via MDP
novel_contributions.description: Value iteration on the MDP formulation of the DFA matching problem gives tight bounds for the single-stream-advancement model. The policy is non-greedy: the optimal DFA selectively skips matchable pairs to improve future matching.
novel_contributions.improvement_over_prior: New algorithm, but weaker model than prior two-pointer approach

novel_contributions.name: Concept tree exploration and reframing
novel_contributions.description: 11 domain reframings identified future research directions including tropical geometry, quantum information, optimal transport, and stochastic control approaches.

best_interval_this_work.note: The conjectural upper bound (0.808) is below the conjectural estimate (0.812), suggesting the gap analysis may underestimate the LCS value slightly at n=200

best_estimate_gamma_2.method: Finite-size scaling with β=2/3 correction exponent

ranking_of_approaches_by_promise.name: Bernoulli LPP correlation gap
ranking_of_approaches_by_promise.reason: Only approach that could beat the 2009 upper bound. Needs rigorous correlation inequality.

ranking_of_approaches_by_promise.name: Lueker feasible-triplet optimization (scaled up)
ranking_of_approaches_by_promise.reason: Proven framework, Heineman reached 0.7927. Further optimization could push higher.

ranking_of_approaches_by_promise.name: Frog dynamics / periodic word optimization
ranking_of_approaches_by_promise.reason: Near-optimal periodic words may provide insight into the structure of γ₂.

ranking_of_approaches_by_promise.name: DFA with two-pointer model
ranking_of_approaches_by_promise.reason: Structural improvement over our single-stream model could recover Dancik's 0.774+.

ranking_of_approaches_by_promise.name: Tropical geometry / algebraic methods
ranking_of_approaches_by_promise.reason: Unexplored direction from reframing; high risk, high reward.
